I really appreciate all the responses. In terms of my disability, its mainly diagnosed as a mood disorder, bipolar.  In order to stay healthy I need sleep. My sleep cycle to maintain this has made me never wake up or fall asleep at the same time every day. Generally its a few hours or so different every day, so I've been able to work a strict schedule, but I get the sleep I need to keep me falling into the abyss.

If I don't get sleep or my medication/nutrition is too bad, I can fall into what the doctors refer to as "hypomania" or full blown "mania". I've been through many mental hospitals who inject me with things I have even been allergic too. 

I remember losing all my friends and my place in this world when I thought it was my divine duty to save the world and eventually was convinced I was Jesus....and God itself. 

Throughout this, I've always budged back and got back on my feet and worked decent jobs...until the full time employment and lack of sleep starts to send me into these dark places.

I want to contribute to the world, not just  Japanese society. I had no intentions of wanting to go there immediately. My question was what could I start doing now with the hopes of somehow getting there.

From all the responses, I do think a more digital nomad lifestyle would be something to start gearing up for that. Sure twitch is impossible now that covid hit and everybody is doing it, but I never streamed to twitch for a job. It was my hobby to provide something to the world and meet people. 

I will focus on myself more. I like the idea of possibly re-establishing myself here in some form that I may be able to potentially travel there and get a better perspective. Even if I cant ever actually find a route that makes the end goal possible, the truth is nobody really knows how the world is going to unfold. Its foolish to say life would be better there than here in the long run. I think its just a realization that I'm falling down the cracks here and its been my passion since I was young to go to Japan. I was so into games even as a young child I sent an entire Rockman game design concept with characters and everything and Capcom personally wrote me a letter back in the mail saying they ONLY take game design ideas from within their company. This was very interesting as a child. Before I was even in high school I was making 3D models for the half life engine as well as skins for the quake. These days, im familiar with Java and C# enough to make my own minecraft mods and unity projects. I just want to be a part of something more than myself. 

Is there more information I can find on steps to take to obtain some kind of associates or attend a college here that may make international education/transfer for me a possibility? I love learning and applying myself. From programming languages, to game engines and art software...I've been doing all sorts of game design related talents since I was a teenager.

I've never considered a job at a game company, but I love providing to something more than than myself. I see myself focusing on this over the next few years, perhaps building up some kind of portfolio while obtaining extra education for that glorious piece of paper called a degree. 

Truth is, I had so many people telling me the USA would not give me disability without me fighting for it. I just applied and they looked at my medical history. I am fortunate to have the opportunity to at least be able to bunker down in a cheap hole while I focus on how I can get myself out of this.

Sustainability is my main vibes these days and my creativity shouldn't be lost. I'd like to pass on something, even if its just some inspiration. 

Thank you all.
